errors.text: The proposed 20–30 h milling and 1100–1200 °C SPS window substantially miss the target conditions of 1–6 h milling and 900–1000 °C SPS; these changes risk contamination, phase decomposition, and grain coarsening.
The claimed sintering strain rate of approximately 10^-3 s^-1 is unsupported and does not meaningfully incorporate the target constraints on displacement rate or thermal expansion.

The falsification experiment does not isolate grain-boundary strengthening from solute strengthening. A single HV10 measurement plus grain-size characterization cannot distinguish those mechanisms without controlled grain-size or composition/solution-state comparisons.
The quantitative predictions miss the target nanocrystalline scale and mechanical response: less than 500 nm and 450–550 HV versus less than 48 nm and approximately 675 HV.
The oxygen-controlled HCP suppression and quench-retention mechanism is extrapolated mainly from chemically distinct refractory HEAs and is not validated for CoCrFeNiTi.
